caption: The worked example on two tokens: scores 1 and 0 are divided by √d_k = 1.4142, softmaxed to 0.6698 and 0.3302, and used to mix the value rows, giving output row 1 = [0.6698, 0.3302]. The dashed side branch shows row 1 when the √d_k scaling is dropped: 0.7311 and 0.2689.

spec.title: Scaled dot-product attention: worked example
spec.aria: Row 1 of the example has scores 1 and 0, divided by √2 = 1.4142 to give 0.7071 and 0, softmaxed to weights 0.6698 and 0.3302, which mix the two value rows into output row [0.6698, 0.3302]; a dashed branch shows the unscaled weights 0.7311 and 0.2689.
